verdicts.originalText: Shield values assume every paw hits (2 for Press, 5 for Hold). Shield duration scales with paws landed (2.4s per paw at talent level 10);.
verdicts.proposedText: Assumes every paw lands — 2 on Press, 5 on Hold — so absorption and duration are shown at maximum. Fewer hits give a weaker, shorter shield.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate optimistic assumption: shield absorption and duration are baked in as if all paws hit, but partial paw hits aren't modelable (multi-hit swings collapse to one hit; per-paw shield formation not expressible per curator notes). Compressed to the assumption plus its consequence; the '2.4s per paw at talent level 10' constant is curator-facing and already lives in _curatorNotes, so it is demoted. 'Shield duration scales with paws landed' is preserved via 'duration shown at maximum / shorter shield with fewer hits'.

claimsLost.claim: Shield duration is 2.4s per paw landed at talent level 10

demotedNotes: Shield duration = 2.4s per paw landed at talent level 10 (pawDur[9]); the caveat text now conveys the paws-scaling qualitatively. Already recorded in existing curator notes.

verdicts.originalText: Drunken Mist heals only the active character standing inside the stationary field (finite vertical range); characters outside receive nothing.
verdicts.proposedText: The heal is shown on every tick, but only the active character standing inside the field is healed. Anyone outside its limited vertical range receives nothing.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate AoE/positioning omission: the heal targets the active character (summonTick) but the tool can't track whether they stand inside the field, so it renders the tick regardless. Preserved the active-only recipient, the inside-the-field requirement, the finite vertical range, and 'outside receives nothing'; added 'shown on every tick' to frame the divergence (traceable to the summonTick heal effect, not a new game claim). Dropped the summon name (the timeline already labels its row) and demoted 'stationary' (encoded in the summon's mobility field).
demotedNotes: Field is stationary (summon mobility 'stationary'); the caveat's 'standing inside the field' conveys the fixed-position sense for users.
